hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom-curve AMM hook backed by Euler vaults. Instead of using Uniswap concentrated liquidity, it implements a bilateral AMM curve (EulerSwap v1) where all assets are held in Euler vaults. Swaps are handled entirely in beforeSwap via vault deposits/withdrawals and curve invariant verification, returning a BeforeSwapDelta to bypass standard pool math.
